journey.name: save contact during endpoint discovery
journey.description: Requires a disposable authenticated Bitkit identity and an unsaved peer with a readable profile. Delay only the peer's public payment-endpoint lookup after its profile has loaded; leave contact writes available. The native component tests provide deterministic held-read coverage. A complete service journey needs a compatible homeserver fault fixture and must be reported unrun without it. No payment is sent. Opening the saved contact confirms the contact record, not payment-link readiness. iOS titles this screen Contact Saved; Android titles it Contact.

actions.action: Open Contacts and add the unsaved peer by its Pubky key
While payment-endpoint discovery is delayed, verify the peer profile and Save button appear without waiting for the endpoint response
Verify Pay is absent until a payable endpoint has been confirmed
Tap Save once and verify the saved contact details show the peer after the contact write succeeds
Return to Contacts and verify the peer appears only once
Restore endpoint access, reopen the saved contact and retry Pay if needed; do not send a payment or assume the saved confirmation means the link is ready
